author: opus-5.5
body:
[opus 5.5] First triage step done: the extra length comes from the provider's own generation, not from a stall in transport. Content-free, from the provider's per-response timing:
- The stalled control generated 4,697 tokens over 134 s and produced 165 s of audio.
- The two post-cut reads of the same message each generated about 2,050 tokens over about 55 s and produced 68 s of audio.
- A stalled read of the other long message generated 7,263 tokens over 140 s.
- On the stalled control, tokens never paused for more than 0.57 s and audio chunks never for more than 4.9 s.

So during the roughly 75 s stretch with no transcript, the provider keeps generating output that becomes audio but no transcript text. The bridge forwards it faithfully.

Next steps:
1. Measure audio energy over that stretch, to tell silence or filler from speech that has no transcript.
2. Take the timings to the provider side.

No bridge change is indicated so far.

author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] 2026-10-12 investigation (report ~/work/vibe-talk-reports/2026-10-12-voice-runtime-findings.md): the TTS model abandons text at identifiers/URLs and runs to its 2048-token per-sentence cap (~75 s). Two dev-only Kepler overrides (direct verbatim path + runaway guard) currently prevent the stall; the direct path depends on vibe-talk's prompt framing matching byte for byte, now pinned by a test. #187 speaks identifiers/URLs as words, which should reduce guard trips. Remaining work is in the private voice backend (drop the abandoned tail before retry; explicit protocol flag instead of prompt matching). Keeping open for the acceptance matrix.

author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Verified 2026-10-13 09:50Z on devbig014 after the voice stack was rebuilt on the updated private draft stack (TTS sentence stop-and-retry, exact reads routed directly to TTS, the read-aloud prompt framing pinned by a test in vibe-talk): two fresh-session verbatim reads of a 578-character message both PASSED scripts/voice-read-acceptance.py: complete, not interrupted, 35.6 s and 34.0 s of audio, longest gap 2.4 s and 3.2 s, 0.06 s of audio per character. No 75 s stall and no overrun. Unverified: the private-stack fixes are unpublished drafts running locally, so a deployment built from the upstream stack would not have them until they land there.
